title: Code comprehension and writing assessment with a strategy-guiding chatbot
summary: Students solve ten Explain-in-Plain-English questions and five Python code-writing questions while using a GPT-4o chatbot, debugger, and execution tool. The chatbot avoids direct answers and instead prompts decomposition, diverse tests, and tool-assisted reasoning.
